summary: Euroseas Ltd., a Greek deep-sea container-ship operator, filed a routine 6-K furnishing interim financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026, covering six-month operations. The filing reflects ordinary-course items: vessel-owning subsidiaries, charter revenues, related-party management fees paid to Eurobulk, interest-rate swaps, restricted-stock compensation, quarterly dividends, and an existing share-repurchase authorization. No special-situation transaction is disclosed — no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private step, activist stake, strategic review, or management change. There is no deal term, premium, close date, or board recommendation to evaluate; risk-arb relevance is nil.
